name: bomberman-arena
description: Bomberman Arena - jeu multijoueur en réseau (monorepo client / serveur / protocole partagé)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bomberman/shared && npm run build -w @bomberman/server && npm run build -w @bomberman/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bomberman/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bomberman/server && npm run typecheck -w @bomberman/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bomberman/server && npm run test -w @bomberman/client
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w @bomberman/server && npm run coverage -w @bomberman/client
